mapper.sql: id, clearing_account_id, channel_batch_ref, revision, settlement_date, currency, gross_amount, fee_amount, net_amount, cash_direction, declared_line_count, imported_line_count, file_name, file_content_hash, reject_reason, status, cash_confirmed_amount, reconciled_time, maker_id, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_channel_statement WHERE clearing_account_id = #{clearingAccountId} AND channel_batch_ref = #{channelBatchRef} ORDER BY revision
SELECT FROM t_channel_statement ORDER BY settlement_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS statement_count, SUM(CASE cash_direction WHEN 'CREDIT' THEN net_amount WHEN 'DEBIT' THEN -net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS signed_net_amount, SUM(cash_confirmed_amount) AS cash_confirmed_amount FROM t_channel_statement WHERE currency = #{currency} AND status IN ('MATCHING', 'RECONCILED')
AND clearing_account_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM t_clearing_account c WHERE c.entity_no = #{entityNo})
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
